verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships Loop, a documented AI agent that lets users "investigate your logs through natural language instead of writing queries" and build scorers, datasets, and dashboards via natural-language prompts, plus Patterns which autonomously surfaces issues. This is reinforced by an official MCP server and CLI enabling natural-language-driven agent workflows from tools like Claude Code/Cursor. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence corroborating Loop's natural-language accuracy or breadth beyond vendor docs.
